title: Screen check — Add quote / e-mail template

steps.do: Open the screen: Go to Sales → CRM — Sales reports → Add quote / e-mail template (or type /crm-template-new after the site address).
steps.expect: The page heading reads "Add quote / e-mail template"; the breadcrumb reads Home › Sales › CRM — Sales reports; the page loads in under 3 seconds with no error.
steps.observed: Opened without error in 85 ms; heading "Add quote / e-mail template"; breadcrumb Home › Sales › CRM — Sales reports › New.

steps.do: Read the line under the heading.
steps.expect: It says: "Type these exactly (with the double braces) anywhere in your .docx — including the header/footer. For the line-item table, put the l_ tokens inside one table row; that row repeats for every line autom" — and it is true for what you see.
steps.observed: The line reads as the test says. (Whether it is true for what you see is checked by the other steps.)

steps.do: Form “Add template”: fill every field with valid values and press “Add template”.
steps.expect: Saved with a confirmation message; the saved values show exactly as typed when reopened.
steps.observed: Saved — "Template added." (new: crm_templates); the values show as typed when reopened.

steps.do: Same form: press “Add template” with everything empty.
steps.expect: Refused with one clear sentence naming what is missing; no half-saved record.
steps.observed: Refused before sending — the browser points at the first missing box: "Please fill out this field. — name". Nothing was saved.

steps.do: Field "Template name *" (text · required) — try a normal value; then leave it empty; then 300 characters; then special characters  & < > " ' ₹ ; then Hindi/Gujarati text (नमस्ते / નમસ્તે).
steps.expect: Normal value saves and shows exactly as typed. It is required: leaving it empty is refused with a message saying so. A 300-character value is cut or refused with a message. Special characters and Indian scripts show exactly as typed, never as code. A refusal keeps everything else you typed.
steps.observed: Tried — a normal value: accepted ("Template added."); empty: refused by the form ("Please fill out this field."); 300 characters: accepted ("Template added."); special characters: accepted ("Template added."); Hindi/Gujarati: accepted ("Template added."). Nothing broke; what was accepted shows as typed.

steps.do: Field "Kind" (select) — try each choice in turn: Quotation document (.docx template), Email — quotation covering note, Email — follow-up reminder, Email — candidate credential request (4 choices).
steps.expect: Each choice saves and is still selected when the record is reopened.
steps.observed: Tried — "Quotation document (.docx template)": accepted ("Template added."); "Email — quotation covering note": accepted ("Template added."); "Email — follow-up reminder": accepted ("Template added."); "Email — candidate credential request": accepted ("Template added."). Nothing broke; what was accepted shows as typed.

steps.do: Field "Default for this kind" (checkbox) — try tick it, save; untick it, save.
steps.expect: The tick is remembered both ways.
steps.observed: Tried — ticked: accepted ("Template added."); unticked: accepted ("Template added."). Nothing broke; what was accepted shows as typed.

steps.do: Field "Active" (checkbox) — try tick it, save; untick it, save.
steps.expect: The tick is remembered both ways.
steps.observed: Tried — ticked: accepted ("Template added."); unticked: accepted ("Template added."). Nothing broke; what was accepted shows as typed.

steps.expect: Normal value saves and shows exactly as typed. A 300-character value is cut or refused with a message. Special characters and Indian scripts show exactly as typed, never as code. A refusal keeps everything else you typed.

steps.do: Field "Issue / effective date" (date) — try today; then a past date (01-01-2019); then a far future date (31-12-2035); then leave it empty.
steps.expect: Dates save and show in your date format. Past and future dates are accepted only where they make sense. Where there is a matching end/"to" date, an end before the start is refused.
steps.observed: Tried — today: accepted ("Template added."); 01-01-2019: accepted ("Template added."); 31-12-2035: accepted ("Template added."); empty: accepted ("Template added."). Nothing broke; what was accepted shows as typed.

steps.do: Field "Word format file (.docx)" (file) — try one allowed file; then several at once; then a file that is too large; then a file type that should not be allowed (.exe).
steps.expect: Allowed files attach and are listed. Too-large and wrong-type files are refused with a message naming the limit.
steps.observed: too large (30 MB) was accepted. Tried — one allowed file: accepted ("Template added."); several at once: the box takes one file at a time; too large (30 MB): accepted ("Template added."); an .exe: refused — ""robot-sample.exe" is a program file. Attach a document or a picture instead. Nothing else on the form was saved either "

steps.do: Field "E-mail subject (for e-mail templates)" (text) — try a normal value; then leave it empty; then 300 characters; then special characters  & < > " ' ₹ ; then Hindi/Gujarati text (नमस्ते / નમસ્તે).
steps.expect: Normal value saves and shows exactly as typed. A 300-character value is cut or refused with a message. Special characters and Indian scripts show exactly as typed, never as code. A refusal keeps everything else you typed.
steps.observed: Tried — a normal value: accepted ("Template added."); empty: accepted ("Template added."); 300 characters: accepted ("Template added."); special characters: accepted ("Template added."); Hindi/Gujarati: accepted ("Template added."). Nothing broke; what was accepted shows as typed.

steps.do: Field "E-mail body" (textarea) — try several lines with line breaks; then 3,000 characters; then leave it empty.
steps.expect: Line breaks are kept when the record is reopened and printed. Very long text is kept or refused with a message — never a blank page.
steps.observed: Tried — several lines: accepted ("Template added."); 3,000 characters: accepted ("Template added."); empty: accepted ("Template added."). Nothing broke; what was accepted shows as typed.

steps.do: Same form: press “Add template” twice quickly (double-click).
steps.expect: Saved once — never two records.
steps.observed: Pressed twice quickly: saved once (crm_templates +1).

steps.do: Button / link "← CRM — Sales reports" — press it.
steps.expect: It opens the screen at /crm-dashboard; Back returns here.
steps.observed: Opened /crm-dashboard; Back returns here.

steps.do: Button / link "Cancel" — press it.
steps.expect: It opens the screen at /crm-templates; Back returns here.
steps.observed: Opened /crm-templates; Back returns here.

steps.do: Narrow the window to phone width (about 390 pixels) or open on a phone.
steps.expect: Readable and usable without the whole page scrolling sideways; buttons big enough to tap.
steps.observed: On a phone (390 px) the page does not scroll sideways; buttons are big enough to tap.
